verdict.rationale: GitCafe has no built-in AI reviewer. It does run an official MCP server that lets external AI tools such as Claude and ChatGPT read pull requests, reviews and CI results and, with approval, work on pull requests. WebMCP and agent skills extend this to browser agents and coding assistants, so AI-assisted review is possible only by bringing your own AI tool. Missing for 10: a native AI reviewer that analyzes diffs automatically, inline AI-suggested fixes in the review UI, documentation of an AI review workflow, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
